compare.palette_de.why: share-weighted CIEDE2000 between palettes; under 6 reads as the same colour world

look.aspect.why: the frame shape a format is designed for

look.density.why: edge density stands in for how much text and graphic detail a frame carries

look.grain.why: added grain or clean digital surfaces; wide because compression flattens it

look.luma_hist.why: earth-mover distance between 16-bin luminance histograms; 0.04 keeps the same key (dark, bright or mid)

look.margins.bottom.why: safe margin depth keeps layouts breathing the same way

look.margins.left.why: safe margin depth keeps layouts breathing the same way

look.margins.right.why: safe margin depth keeps layouts breathing the same way

look.margins.top.why: safe margin depth keeps layouts breathing the same way

look.sharpness.why: crisp vector graphics against soft footage or blur is part of the look; wide because content shifts it

motion.energy_stats.mean.why: overall motion per second, in frame long-sides; more or less than this reads busier or calmer

motion.energy_stats.mean_norm.why: mean over peak: low means rare spikes over calm, high means sustained motion

motion.energy_stats.p90.why: how hard the energetic moments hit

motion.move_stats.fitted_duration_median.why: typical duration of a cleanly fitted move is the style's timing unit

motion.move_stats.overshoot_share.why: whether moves settle with overshoot or land dead is a signature of the curve family

motion.move_stats.per_10s.why: how many separate things move, loosely, since segmentation is noisy

timing.cuts_per_10s.why: edit rate (hard cuts plus soft transitions) is the first thing that reads as a different hand

timing.hard_cut_share.why: whether scenes change by hard cut or by designed transition is a signature choice

timing.hold_share.why: how much of the runtime sits still is the breathing room of the style

timing.shot_length.median.why: typical shot length is the editor's pulse; 15% is about where a viewer feels the pace change

timing.shot_length.p10.why: the shortest shots set how hard the fastest passages hit

timing.shot_length.p90.why: the longest shots set how long the piece is willing to sit
